title: Collections Standing Schedule: Days Past Due at Suspension and Charge-Off, Personal Credit Cards
content:
Two milestones measured in days past due are fixed for each tier of Personal Credit Cards: the day count at which charging privileges are suspended, and the day count at which the balance is charged off.

| Tier | Days past due at suspension | Days past due at charge-off |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 60 | 180 |
| College Rewards Visa | 60 | 180 |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 60 | 180 |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 60 | 180 |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 60 | 180 |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 60 | 180 |

Both milestones are uniform across the tiers: 60 days past due at suspension and 180 days past due at charge-off, whichever card the customer holds.
